commands.name: mac-deps-before
argv: import importlib.metadata as m,json; print(json.dumps(dict(sorted((d.metadata["Name"],d.version) for d in m.distributions()))))

commands.name: mac-installed-smoke
argv:
import json,runpy,sys
runpy.run_module("tools.installed_smoke",run_name="__main__")
roots=("torch","mlx","ctranslate2","faster_whisper","onnxruntime","transformers","piper","speechbrain","silero_vad","parakeet_mlx")
loaded=[root for root in roots if root in sys.modules]
import threading
pollers=[thread.name for thread in threading.enumerate() if thread.name in ("audio-watcher","metrics-sampler","verse-watcher","diarize-watcher")]
native=[name for name in ("sounddevice",) if name in sys.modules]
print(json.dumps({"model_runtime_modules_loaded":loaded,"native_device_modules_loaded":native,"polling_workers_after_lifespan":pollers}))
assert not loaded, loaded
assert not pollers, pollers

commands.name: mac-native-exit-1
argv:
import json,sys,threading
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from operator_app.main import app
with TestClient(app,base_url="http://127.0.0.1",client=("127.0.0.1",50000)) as client:
    assert client.get("/healthz").status_code == 200
    response=client.get("/api/devices")
    data=response.json()
    assert response.status_code == 200, data.get("error")
roots=("torch","mlx","ctranslate2","faster_whisper","onnxruntime","transformers","piper","speechbrain","silero_vad","parakeet_mlx")
loaded=[name for name in roots if name in sys.modules]
pollers=[thread.name for thread in threading.enumerate() if thread.name in ("audio-watcher","metrics-sampler","verse-watcher","diarize-watcher")]
assert "sounddevice" in sys.modules, "Real device enumeration did not import sounddevice"
print(json.dumps({"device_endpoint_status":response.status_code,"input_devices":len(data["inputs"]),"output_devices":len(data["outputs"]),"model_runtime_modules_loaded":loaded,"native_device_modules_loaded":["sounddevice"],"polling_workers_after_lifespan":pollers,"microphone_or_output_stream_opened":False}))
assert not loaded, loaded
assert not pollers, pollers
